Peak Form Climbing

A small bouldering gym in Silverton, Oregon, run by three people who still set every route themselves.

We opened in 2019 with fifteen routes, one slab wall, and a stubborn belief that gyms should be quiet enough to hear yourself think. Seven years on, we have forty-eight routes on two walls, a cramped but honest training corner, and the same three owners behind the desk on rotation.

Our setters work in small teams and climb the gym on their own time, so the grades hold up. If a route feels sandbagged, tell us at the front desk; we have a notebook and we use it.

What you get with a day pass

  • Access to all forty-eight routes, two of them new every Tuesday
  • The training corner: one hangboard, one campus board, one erg, shared without drama
  • Coffee from the machine that has not broken since 2021, and chalk we sell at cost

Day passes are $16, or $12 after 7pm on weeknights. Monthly memberships are $58 with no sign-up fee, and a 10-visit punch card runs $135. We do not do first-month promos, because the gym is not a gym that needs to sell you on itself.

Practical things

We are at 214 Water Street, in the brick building next to the feed store. Parking is behind the building and free. The bus stops two blocks away on Oak, and the #4 runs until 9:40pm on weekdays.

Minors under 14 climb free when a member of their household is present; everyone else needs a waiver, which takes about four minutes because we read it out loud with you.

Questions people ask

Do we have classes for beginners? Yes — a six-week intro course on Sunday afternoons, capped at eight people, and the next one starts on the first Sunday of every month. It covers falling, reading a route, and the difference between a crimp and a pinch.

Is the gym good for kids? The bouldering room is open to climbers under 14 on Saturday mornings with two staff on the floor, and plenty of members bring toddlers on weekday mornings, when the gym is almost empty.

Can we rent shoes? Shoes are $5, harnesses are $4, and both are washed between uses, mostly because Marta insisted.

Member words

"I drive past two other gyms to climb here. The grades are honest and nobody yells." — Priya, member since 2021.

"My kids learned to fall here, which sounds odd until you watch them do it well." — Tom, parent of two juniors.

"It is the only gym I have been to where the owners remember your name." — Sam, punch-card regular.

Questions that are not answered here: call the front desk at 503-555-0184, or stop by — we are open from 10am to 10pm daily, and until 11pm on Fridays.
